commands.name: 辞任
commands.probeNote: | implementing needs the character's current card as authority state (world entry serves the constant AuthorityCardId 39) | 20260903 analysis: 辞任 always sends cardId=39 (the player's OWN authored card 艦隊司令官, served as the constant AuthorityCardId at world entry), NOT an appointed post. There is no picker — it resigns the player from their base command card. A positive verification is blocked on a design decision: what a player with no post should become (the original game strips the command). Distinct from 罷免 (0x0708, VERIFIED), which removes ANOTHER post's holder from original_character_card. Not implementable as a clean inverse without that decision. | CORRECTION 20260903T085429Z (extracmd38, LOGH7_WORLD_CARD_ID=0): the earlier 'undefined design' claim was WRONG. constmsg group 3 row 0 = 個人 and group 4 row 0 = 皇宮, and serving card 0 in the world-entry character record makes the unmodified client render 職務権限カード as 「皇宮 ： 個人」 with an empty command grid, no crash, HUD intact. Card 0 is the ORIGINAL's own first-class 'holds no post' state, so 辞任 has a defined target state and IS implementable: resign -> character card becomes 0. | IMPLEMENTED+VERIFIED 20260903T090158Z (extracmd39): migration 0015 widens original_character_card.card_id to allow 0 and adds original_card_resignation_command; ResignCardAsync sets the card to 0 and emits CharacterCardResigned; world entry now serves the PERSISTED card (LoadPersistedCardAsync -> EffectiveWorldCardId) instead of the constant AuthorityCardId. 辞任 at card (722,310) with one extra command -> confirm 決定(565,516) -> 0x0709 from=39 to=0 -> restart + relogin -> client renders 「皇宮 ： 個人」 with an empty command grid.
